samples.summary: Phase 31's design record still describes the UI verifier contract as it was before `scopedTitle`/`overclaimed` became required schema fields, and still implies the explorer's title is what a maintainer reads
samples.evidence: docs/design/harness-engineering.md:2255-2272 is the canonical record of what differs between the two hunters ("Only two things genuinely differ — the permitted `confirmationGround` values, and where citations come from") and of what the verifiers are the sole source of (`groundedIn`). This change makes the verifiers the sole source of a THIRD thing — the report heading — and adds two required fields to `UI_VERIFIER_SCHEMA` (scripts/agent/hunt-gate.mjs:250-259) plus a new funnel row (`overclaimed`). The doc is unchanged, so the out-of-diff design record now understates the verifier contract. The enforced docs lane only checks that backticked paths resolve, never content, so nothing else catches this.

samples.summary: Adding `overclaimed` to the stats object silently changes the report's Funnel table and `run.json` shape for every UI run, not just runs that overclaim
samples.evidence: `renderUiReport` renders the funnel from `...Object.entries(stats).map(...)` (scripts/agent/hunt-ui.mjs:740) and `cmdRun` serialises the same object into `run.json` (scripts/agent/hunt-ui.mjs:1036-1041). The new key is initialised in `runHunt`'s stats literal between `unjudgedVerifier` and `cappedUnverified` (scripts/agent/hunt-ui.mjs:1128), so an extra row appears in a fixed position in every report, including seeded control runs where it is always 0 — unlike the stdout line, which is conditional on `stats.overclaimed > 0`. I found no machine consumer of the funnel table or of hunt-ui's `run.json` (no .github workflow references hunt-ui; metrics.mjs reads only `hunt-ui-execution.json`), so this is a cosmetic/format change rather than a break, but it is a shape change to two published artifacts made outside their own tests.

samples.summary: `uiScopedTitle` narrows only the report heading; the defect ledger, the drop table and the verifier prompt still key on / display the explorer's un-narrowed title, so a filed issue and its run artifacts disagree
samples.evidence: The narrowed claim is attached only to reported records (scripts/agent/hunt-ui.mjs:1357). Everything else out of diff still uses `claimed.title`: the drop table (`d.title`, scripts/agent/hunt-ui.mjs:832), the capped section heading (scripts/agent/hunt-ui.mjs:819), the verifier error log (`cand.title`, scripts/agent/hunt-ui.mjs:1342) and the verifier prompt itself (scripts/agent/hunt-ui.mjs:564). The ledger entry carries only the defect key (scripts/agent/hunt-ui.mjs:1362), so dedupe is unaffected — but a reader tracing a filed issue's heading back through run.json/report drops will not find that string anywhere except the one blockquote. Low impact; noted because the narrowing is now the maintainer-facing identity of a finding and only one of five title sites was updated.
